settings.title: PREMIUM HANDWOVEN COCO MATS - 1.5" THICK
settings.text:
Our premier 1.5” thick handwoven coco doormats are the ultimate choice, with a dense weave packed full of coco fiber.

Sustainably produced, they provide double the fabric of BR quality mats, creating a luxurious and compact design.

settings.title: HANDWOVEN COCO MATS - 1" THICK
settings.text:
These 1” thick handwoven coco mats offer a smaller rendition of our Premium counterparts.

While thickness marks a significant contrast, these mats also showcase a handwoven braid along the edges, crafted entirely from sustainably sourced coconut husk fibers.

settings.title: VINYL BACKED COCO DOORMATS - 5/8" THICK
settings.text:
Our modern coco doormats feature eco-friendly coco fibers embedded in PVC vinyl backing.

This sleek design effectively scrapes away dirt and debris while preventing water leakage.

settings.title: SUSTAINABLE MATS
settings.text:
Crafted from the finest coconut fibers, our coco mats are designed to make a lasting impression at your doorstep. With their natural texture and durability, they offer a charming blend of functionality and style.

Keep dirt and debris at bay while adding a touch of rustic sophistication to your home's entrance.

settings.subtitle: Tailored to Your Taste
settings.title: Custom Coco Mats
settings.text:
Embrace eco-style with our customizable coco mats, crafted from renewable coconut husk fibers for durability and sustainability.

Transform your doorway into a personalized green oasis, welcoming guests with natural beauty and conscientious living.
